skill_name: Compare and contrast the health benefits of eating organic food vs non-organic food.
workflow: Organic food is grown in a more sustainable and health-conscious way, using natural fertilizers and no synthetic pesticides, so it tends to have fewer chemical additives and residual pesticides compared to non-organic food. Organic food is also higher in vitamins, minerals, and overall nutrition than non-organic food.
